sources.parameterized_source_utf8:
"""One-shot, message-only CI retry on the existing reviewed integration branch."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
RUN = Path(PARAMETERS['run_directory']).resolve()
ATTEMPT = RUN / ('recovery-attempts/' + PARAMETERS['task_id'] + '-original')
OLD = PARAMETERS['old_head_sha']

def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def save(path, value):
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        os.chmod(path, 384)
        stream.write(value)

def main():
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex
    evidence = RUN / 'ci-delay-investigation'
    evidence.mkdir(mode=448, exist_ok=True)
    state_raw = (RUN / 'recovery-queue-state.json').read_bytes()
    state = json.loads(state_raw)
    assert state['tasks'][PARAMETERS['task_id']]['status'] == 'head_ci_failed_or_cutoff'
    assert state['tasks'][PARAMETERS['task_id']]['head_sha'] == OLD and state['paused'] is False
    assert (RUN / 'integration-control.stop').is_file()
    try:
        os.kill(PARAMETERS['stopped_queue_pid'], 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('original queue still exists')
    assert json.loads((RUN / 'recovery-journal.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()[-1])['kind'] == 'integration_queue_stopped'
    release = json.loads((RUN / 'workload-release.json').read_text())
    assert datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() + 300 < datetime.fromisoformat(release['delivery_cutoff_utc']).timestamp()
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery_phase', RUN / 'recover-reviewed-phase.py')
    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
    project, original, review = helper.context(PARAMETERS['task_id'], ATTEMPT)
    with helper.pi.integration_lock(helper.common_state(project.root)):
        assert (RUN / 'recovery-queue-state.json').read_bytes() == state_raw
        assert (RUN / 'integration-control.stop').is_file()
        assert datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() + 300 < datetime.fromisoformat(release['delivery_cutoff_utc']).timestamp()
        admission = helper.admit(PARAMETERS['task_id'], original, review, project)
        helper.verify_copy(ATTEMPT, admission)
        integ = helper.verify_candidate(ATTEMPT, admission, project, committed=True)
        assert integ['head_sha'] == OLD and integ['status'] == 'published'
        assert integ['pr_number'] == PARAMETERS['pr_number']
        root = Path(integ['worktree'])

        def git(*args):
            return helper.pi.command(['git', *args], root).decode().strip()

        def read_api(endpoint):
            proc = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', '--method', 'GET', 'repos/' + PARAMETERS['repository'] + '/' + endpoint], capture_output=True, timeout=45, check=True)
            save(evidence / (endpoint.replace('/', '-') + '-' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.json'), proc.stdout)
            return json.loads(proc.stdout)
        pr = read_api('pulls/' + str(PARAMETERS['pr_number']))
        assert pr['state'] == 'open' and pr['merged'] is False
        assert pr['head']['sha'] == OLD and pr['head']['ref'] == integ['branch']
        assert pr['base']['sha'] == integ['tested_base_sha'] and pr['base']['ref'] == 'main'
        assert read_api('git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'] == integ['tested_base_sha']
        assert git('status', '--porcelain') == ''
        assert git('rev-list', '--parents', '-n', '1', OLD).split() == [OLD, integ['tested_base_sha']]
        original_raw = (ATTEMPT / 'integration.json').read_bytes()
        archived = evidence / f'integration-before-ci-head-retry-{token}.json'
        save(archived, original_raw)
        save(evidence / f'queue-before-ci-head-retry-{token}.json', state_raw)
        save(evidence / f'old-commit-{token}.txt', helper.pi.command(['git', 'cat-file', 'commit', OLD], root))
        git('commit', '--amend', '-m', PARAMETERS['commit_message'])
        new = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
        assert new != OLD
        assert git('rev-list', '--parents', '-n', '1', new).split() == [new, integ['tested_base_sha']]
        assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}') == integ['tested_tree']
        assert git('write-tree') == integ['tested_tree'] and git('status', '--porcelain') == ''
        assert git('diff', OLD, new, '--') == ''
        exact = helper.pi.command(['git', '-c', 'core.abbrev=7', 'diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-textconv', '--no-renames', '--binary', integ['tested_base_sha'], '--'], root)
        assert exact == admission['raw']['changes.patch']
        prepared = {'old_head_sha': OLD, 'new_head_sha': new, 'tree': integ['tested_tree'], 'parent': integ['tested_base_sha'], 'at_utc': helper.pi.now(), 'remote_mutation_attempted': True, 'outcome': 'unconfirmed', 'branch': integ['branch']}
        save(evidence / f'head-retry-prepush-{token}.json', (json.dumps(prepared, indent=2) + '\n').encode())
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(['git', 'push', '--force-with-lease=refs/heads/' + integ['branch'] + ':' + OLD, 'origin', 'HEAD:refs/heads/' + integ['branch']], cwd=root, capture_output=True, timeout=90, check=False)
        except BaseException as error:
            save(evidence / f'head-retry-push-result-{token}.json', (json.dumps({'ended_at_utc': helper.pi.now(), 'outcome': 'uncertain', 'error_type': type(error).__name__}) + '\n').encode())
            raise
        save(evidence / f'head-retry-push-{token}.stdout', proc.stdout)
        save(evidence / f'head-retry-push-{token}.stderr', proc.stderr)
        save(evidence / f'head-retry-push-result-{token}.json', (json.dumps({'ended_at_utc': helper.pi.now(), 'outcome': 'command_succeeded_requires_remote_confirmation' if proc.returncode == 0 else 'failed_or_uncertain', 'return_code': proc.returncode}) + '\n').encode())
        assert proc.returncode == 0, 'push uncertain/failed: preserve state and reconcile; never retry automatically'
        pr = read_api('pulls/' + str(PARAMETERS['pr_number']))
        assert pr['head']['sha'] == new and pr['head']['ref'] == integ['branch']
        assert pr['base']['sha'] == integ['tested_base_sha'] and pr['merged'] is False
        assert read_api('git/commits/' + new)['tree']['sha'] == integ['tested_tree']
        at = helper.pi.now()
        attestation = {'kind': 'coordinator_same_tree_ci_retry', 'actor': 'root', 'task_id': PARAMETERS['task_id'], 'pr_number': PARAMETERS['pr_number'], 'old_head_sha': OLD, 'new_head_sha': new, 'tested_base_sha': integ['tested_base_sha'], 'tested_tree': integ['tested_tree'], 'reviewed_patch_sha256': admission['patch_sha'], 'review_receipt_sha256': digest(admission['review_raw']), 'original_integration_sha256': digest(original_raw), 'preserved_original_integration_path': str(archived), 'old_queue_state_sha256': digest(state_raw), 'recorded_at_utc': at, 'exact_old_head_lease_succeeded': True, 'code_delta': False, 'new_paid_workers': 0, 'original_reviewed_at_preserved': True, 'original_published_at_preserved': True, 'additional_CI_cost_usd': None}
        integ.update(head_sha=new, coordinator_ci_retry_at=at, coordinator_ci_retry_old_head=OLD)
        helper.pi.save(ATTEMPT / 'integration.json', integ)
        helper.verify_candidate(ATTEMPT, admission, project, committed=True)
        path = evidence / f'same-tree-attestation-{token}.json'
        raw = (json.dumps(attestation, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
        save(path, raw)
        print(json.dumps({'attestation_path': str(path), 'sha256': digest(raw), 'new_head_sha': new}))
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Reconcile the already successful lease push; never retry any remote write."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
RUN = Path(PARAMETERS['run_directory']).resolve()
OLD = PARAMETERS['old_head_sha']
NEW = PARAMETERS['new_head_sha']
TOKEN = PARAMETERS['retry_token']

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def save(path, raw):
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        os.chmod(path, 384)
        stream.write(raw)

def main():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery_phase', RUN / 'recover-reviewed-phase.py')
    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
    attempt = RUN / ('recovery-attempts/' + PARAMETERS['task_id'] + '-original')
    evidence = RUN / 'ci-delay-investigation'
    project, original, review = helper.context(PARAMETERS['task_id'], attempt)
    with helper.pi.integration_lock(helper.common_state(project.root)):
        assert (RUN / 'integration-control.stop').is_file()
        old_state_raw = (evidence / f'queue-before-ci-head-retry-{TOKEN}.json').read_bytes()
        assert (RUN / 'recovery-queue-state.json').read_bytes() == old_state_raw
        assert json.loads(old_state_raw)['tasks'][PARAMETERS['task_id']]['head_sha'] == OLD
        original_path = evidence / f'integration-before-ci-head-retry-{TOKEN}.json'
        original_raw = original_path.read_bytes()
        assert (attempt / 'integration.json').read_bytes() == original_raw
        integ = json.loads(original_raw)
        admission = helper.admit(PARAMETERS['task_id'], original, review, project)
        helper.verify_copy(attempt, admission)
        push = json.loads((evidence / f'head-retry-push-result-{TOKEN}.json').read_text())
        prepared = json.loads((evidence / f'head-retry-prepush-{TOKEN}.json').read_text())
        assert push['return_code'] == 0 and prepared['old_head_sha'] == OLD and (prepared['new_head_sha'] == NEW)
        assert prepared['branch'] == integ['branch'] and integ['status'] == 'published'
        assert integ['pr_number'] == PARAMETERS['pr_number'] and integ['head_sha'] == OLD

        def read_api(endpoint):
            proc = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', '--method', 'GET', 'repos/' + PARAMETERS['repository'] + '/' + endpoint], capture_output=True, timeout=45, check=True)
            save(evidence / ('reconcile-' + endpoint.replace('/', '-') + '-' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.json'), proc.stdout)
            return json.loads(proc.stdout)
        pr = read_api('pulls/' + str(PARAMETERS['pr_number']))
        assert pr['state'] == 'open' and pr['merged'] is False
        assert pr['head']['sha'] == NEW and pr['head']['ref'] == integ['branch']
        assert pr['base']['sha'] == integ['tested_base_sha'] and pr['base']['ref'] == 'main'
        assert read_api('git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'] == integ['tested_base_sha']
        for head in (OLD, NEW):
            commit = read_api('git/commits/' + head)
            assert commit['tree']['sha'] == integ['tested_tree']
            assert [p['sha'] for p in commit['parents']] == [integ['tested_base_sha']]
        current = dict(integ, head_sha=NEW)
        root = helper.pi.candidate(current, admission['task'], committed=True)
        exact = helper.pi.command(['git', '-c', 'core.abbrev=7', 'diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-textconv', '--no-renames', '--binary', integ['tested_base_sha'], '--'], root)
        assert exact == admission['raw']['changes.patch']
        assert not helper.pi.command(['git', 'diff', OLD, NEW, '--'], root)
        at = helper.pi.now()
        attestation = {'kind': 'coordinator_same_tree_ci_retry', 'actor': 'root', 'task_id': PARAMETERS['task_id'], 'pr_number': PARAMETERS['pr_number'], 'old_head_sha': OLD, 'new_head_sha': NEW, 'tested_base_sha': integ['tested_base_sha'], 'tested_tree': integ['tested_tree'], 'reviewed_patch_sha256': admission['patch_sha'], 'review_receipt_sha256': sha(admission['review_raw']), 'original_integration_sha256': sha(original_raw), 'preserved_original_integration_path': str(original_path), 'old_queue_state_sha256': sha(old_state_raw), 'recorded_at_utc': at, 'exact_old_head_lease_succeeded': True, 'code_delta': False, 'new_paid_workers': 0, 'original_reviewed_at_preserved': True, 'original_published_at_preserved': True, 'additional_CI_cost_usd': None, 'push_confirmed_by_separate_GET_only_reconciliation': True, 'push_retry_count': 0, 'original_immediate_postpush_check_failed': True, 'original_retry_script_sha256': '6569bbe1a9c2b036f1ba0dbbbd7291a3752a5d2b90e6cd1b3826130c6fb490e7'}
        path = evidence / f'same-tree-attestation-{TOKEN}.json'
        raw = (json.dumps(attestation, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
        save(path, raw)
        current.update(coordinator_ci_retry_at=at, coordinator_ci_retry_old_head=OLD)
        helper.pi.save(attempt / 'integration.json', current)
        helper.verify_candidate(attempt, admission, project, committed=True)
        print(json.dumps({'attestation_path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'new_head_sha': NEW}))
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

sources.parameterized_source_utf8:
"""One-shot, explicit reconciliation of the stopped B096 CI wait.

No queue body runs on import. Root invokes this helper only after exact-head CI
is genuinely green. Original worker artifacts and semantic review are unchanged.
The existing merge helper performs every normal policy/base/tree/CI gate.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import copy
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
RUN = Path(PARAMETERS['run_directory']).resolve()
TASK = PARAMETERS['task_id']
PR = PARAMETERS['pr_number']
OLD_HEAD = PARAMETERS['old_head_sha']
QUEUE_SHA = PARAMETERS['expected_queue_source_sha256']
PHASE_SHA = PARAMETERS['expected_phase_source_sha256']

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def aware(value):
    result = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    require(result.utcoffset() is not None, 'aware timestamp required')
    return result

def write_once(path, raw):
    with os.fdopen(os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 384), 'wb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())

def read(path):
    require(path.is_file() and (not path.is_symlink()), 'missing or unsafe input')
    return path.read_bytes()

def queue_processes(queue):
    matches = []
    for item in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not item.name.isdigit():
            continue
        try:
            arguments = (item / 'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\x00')
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
            continue
        if os.fsencode(str(queue)) in arguments:
            matches.append(int(item.name))
    return matches

def load_queue_prefix(queue):
    raw = read(queue)
    require(sha(raw) == QUEUE_SHA, 'queue source changed')
    tree = ast.parse(raw, filename=str(queue))
    stops = [i for i, node in enumerate(tree.body) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
    require(stops and 'owner-release.json' in ast.get_source_segment(raw.decode(), tree.body[stops[0]]), 'unexpected queue entry boundary')
    prefix = ast.Module(body=tree.body[:stops[0]], type_ignores=[])
    require(not any((isinstance(node, (ast.While, ast.For)) for node in prefix.body)), 'queue loop cannot be imported')
    namespace = {'__file__': str(queue), '__name__': 'stopped_queue_prefix'}
    exec(compile(prefix, str(queue), 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace

def validate_stop(state, events, now, cutoff):
    require(state.get('paused') is False, 'paused state requires separate reconciliation')
    require(len(state.get('tasks', {})) == 59, 'unexpected stopped task set')
    old = state['tasks'].get(TASK, {})
    require(old.get('status') == 'head_ci_failed_or_cutoff' and old.get('head_sha') == OLD_HEAD and (old.get('pr_number') == PR), 'stopped candidate differs')
    require(all((v.get('status') == 'merged_green_provisional' for k, v in state['tasks'].items() if k != TASK)), 'another task requires reconciliation')
    require(all((v.get('status') == 'passed' and v.get('merged_tree_verified') is True and (not v.get('requires_coordinator_reconciliation')) for v in state.get('post_merge_checks', {}).values())), 'combined checks or tree are unresolved')
    require(events and events[-1].get('kind') == 'integration_queue_stopped' and (events[-1].get('paused') is False) and (events[-1].get('cutoff_reached') is False), 'not a genuine pre-cutoff queue stop')
    require(events[-1].get('task_status_counts') == {'head_ci_failed_or_cutoff': 1, 'merged_green_provisional': 58}, 'stop outcomes differ')
    waits = [v for v in events if v.get('kind') == 'head_ci_wait_finished' and v.get('task_id') == TASK]
    require(waits and waits[-1].get('status') == 'pending', 'old CI result was not pending')
    require(aware(waits[-1]['at_utc']) <= aware(events[-1]['at_utc']) <= now and now.timestamp() + 30 < cutoff, 'deadline or stop timestamp invalid')
    return copy.deepcopy(old)

def validate_attestation(record, old_integration, integration, old_state, state_raw, review_sha, now):
    require(record.get('kind') == 'coordinator_same_tree_ci_retry' and record.get('actor') == 'root' and (record.get('task_id') == TASK) and (record.get('pr_number') == PR), 'CI retry identity differs')
    require(record.get('old_head_sha') == OLD_HEAD and record.get('new_head_sha') == integration['head_sha'] != OLD_HEAD, 'CI retry heads differ')
    require(type(record.get('new_paid_workers')) is int and record['new_paid_workers'] == 0 and (record.get('code_delta') is False) and (record.get('exact_old_head_lease_succeeded') is True), 'unbounded or unconfirmed CI retry')
    require(aware(old_state['started_at_utc']) <= aware(record['recorded_at_utc']) <= now, 'CI retry timestamp invalid')
    require(record.get('old_queue_state_sha256') == sha(state_raw), 'CI retry stopped-state binding differs')
    require(record.get('reviewed_patch_sha256') == integration['patch_sha256'] == old_state['patch_sha256'] and record.get('review_receipt_sha256') == review_sha == old_state['review_receipt_sha256'], 'CI retry review or patch differs')
    for key in ['tested_base_sha', 'tested_tree']:
        require(record.get(key) == integration[key] == old_integration[key], 'CI retry parent/tree changed')
    for key in ['branch', 'patch_sha256', 'batch_id', 'application_method', 'checks_started_at', 'checks_finished_at', 'reviewed_at', 'published_at']:
        require(integration.get(key) == old_integration.get(key), 'validated candidate or original review metadata changed')
    require(old_integration.get('head_sha') == OLD_HEAD and old_integration.get('pr_number') == PR and (old_integration.get('status') == 'published'), 'original integration snapshot differs')

def validate_remote(query, checks, integration):
    head = integration['head_sha']
    pr = query(f'pulls/{PR}')
    require(pr.get('state') == 'open' and (not pr.get('merged')) and (pr.get('draft') is False), 'PR is no longer the open candidate')
    require(pr.get('head', {}).get('sha') == head and pr['head'].get('ref') == integration['branch'] and (pr['head'].get('repo', {}).get('full_name') == PARAMETERS['repository']), 'PR head/branch/repository differs')
    require(integration['branch'] != 'main' and pr.get('base', {}).get('ref') == 'main' and (query('git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'] == integration['tested_base_sha']), 'main/base changed')
    for commit in {OLD_HEAD, head}:
        value = query(f'git/commits/{commit}')
        require(value.get('sha') == commit and value.get('tree', {}).get('sha') == integration['tested_tree'] and ([p.get('sha') for p in value.get('parents', [])] == [integration['tested_base_sha']]), 'old/new commit tree or single parent changed')
    status, _ = checks(head)
    require(status == 'passed', 'every actual exact-head check must be complete/success')

def finish_merge(queue, attempt, archive, marker, marker_raw, old, integration, proof):
    """One guarded merge; restore hold even if outcome is uncertain."""
    require(not (archive / 'invoked.json').exists(), 'one-shot reconciliation was already invoked')
    write_once(archive / 'invoked.json', json.dumps(proof, indent=2).encode() + b'\n')
    write_once(archive / 'stop-marker-original.bin', marker_raw)
    queue['event']('head_ci_wait_finished', task_id=TASK, status='passed', wall_seconds=proof['total_head_wait_envelope_seconds'], polls=1, coordinator_ci_reconciliation=True, prior_pending_segment_overlaps_this_total=True, durations_are_not_additive=True, timing_basis='Aware wall envelope from original publication through exact-head-green revalidation; includes coordinator pause and CI retry, not exclusive attention or job CPU.')
    try:
        require(read(marker) == marker_raw, 'hold marker changed before merge')
        marker.unlink()
        code, _, receipt = queue['operation'](TASK, 'merge', [queue['PYTHON'], str(queue['PHASE_HELPER']), 'merge', TASK, '--attempt-dir', str(attempt)])
        require(code == 0, 'merge returned nonzero; uncertain outcome requires separate reconciliation')
        merged = json.loads(read(attempt / 'integration.json'))
        require(merged.get('status') == 'merged' and merged.get('head_sha') == integration['head_sha'] and (merged.get('tested_tree') == integration['tested_tree']), 'merged integration metadata differs')
        pr = queue['query'](f'pulls/{PR}')
        require(pr.get('merged') is True and pr.get('merge_commit_sha') == merged.get('merge_commit_sha') and (pr.get('head', {}).get('sha') == integration['head_sha']), 'actual merge identity unresolved')
        actual = queue['query'](f'git/commits/{merged['merge_commit_sha']}')
        require(actual.get('sha') == merged['merge_commit_sha'] and actual.get('tree', {}).get('sha') == integration['tested_tree'], 'actual merged tree differs')
        require(sha(read(queue['STATE'])) == proof['old_state_sha256'], 'queue changed after merge; separate reconciliation required')
        state = queue['state']
        state.setdefault('task_history', {}).setdefault(TASK, []).append(copy.deepcopy(old))
        state['tasks'][TASK].update(status='merged_pending_combined_ci', head_sha=integration['head_sha'], ended_at_utc=queue['utc'](), merge_commit_sha=merged['merge_commit_sha'], merged_at=merged['merged_at'], merged_tree_verified=True)
        state['post_merge_checks'][TASK] = {'status': 'pending', 'merge_commit_sha': merged['merge_commit_sha'], 'pr_url': old['pr_url'], 'merged_tree_verified': True, 'requires_coordinator_reconciliation': False}
        queue['save']()
        queue['event']('reviewed_head_merged', task_id=TASK, pr_url=old['pr_url'], merge_commit_sha=merged['merge_commit_sha'])
        return {'status': 'merged_pending_combined_ci', 'merge_commit_sha': merged['merge_commit_sha'], 'head_sha': integration['head_sha'], 'merge_operation_receipt': str(receipt), 'combined_ci_or_delivery_credit_claimed': False}
    finally:
        if not marker.exists():
            write_once(marker, marker_raw)

def execute(phase, attestation_path=None, attestation_sha=None):
    queue_path = RUN / 'recover-reviewed-queue.py'
    require(not queue_processes(queue_path), 'old queue process is still active')
    marker = RUN / 'integration-control.stop'
    marker_raw = read(marker)
    state_path, journal_path = (RUN / 'recovery-queue-state.json', RUN / 'recovery-journal.jsonl')
    state_raw, journal_raw = (read(state_path), read(journal_path))
    require(journal_raw.endswith(b'\n'), 'partial journal')
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in journal_raw.splitlines()]
    queue = load_queue_prefix(queue_path)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    old = validate_stop(json.loads(state_raw), events, now, queue['CUTOFF'])
    require(queue['state'] == json.loads(state_raw), 'queue state changed during prefix import')
    approved = queue['approved'](TASK)
    require(approved == (old['patch_sha256'], old['review_receipt_sha256']), 'original approval changed')
    attempt = RUN / 'recovery-attempts' / f'{TASK}-original'
    require(sha(read(RUN / 'recover-reviewed-phase.py')) == PHASE_SHA, 'original merge helper source changed')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_unchanged_phase', RUN / 'recover-reviewed-phase.py')
    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
    project, original, review_path = helper.context(TASK, attempt)
    admission = helper.admit(TASK, original, review_path, project)
    helper.verify_copy(attempt, admission)
    integration = helper.verify_candidate(attempt, admission, project, committed=True)
    require(integration.get('status') == 'published' and integration.get('pr_number') == PR, 'candidate is not the existing published PR')
    attestation = None
    if integration['head_sha'] != OLD_HEAD:
        require(attestation_path is not None and attestation_sha is not None, 'changed head needs explicit same-tree attestation')
        attestation_raw = read(attestation_path)
        require(sha(attestation_raw) == attestation_sha, 'attestation hash differs')
        attestation = json.loads(attestation_raw)
        preserved = Path(attestation['preserved_original_integration_path'])
        require(preserved.resolve().is_relative_to(RUN) and preserved.resolve() == preserved.absolute(), 'unsafe original integration archive')
        preserved_raw = read(preserved)
        require(sha(preserved_raw) == attestation['original_integration_sha256'], 'original integration archive differs')
        validate_attestation(attestation, json.loads(preserved_raw), integration, old, state_raw, old['review_receipt_sha256'], now)
    else:
        require(attestation_path is None and attestation_sha is None, 'unnecessary attestation is ambiguous')
    started = time.monotonic()
    validate_remote(queue['query'], queue['checks'], integration)
    require(not queue_processes(queue_path) and read(state_path) == state_raw and (read(journal_path) == journal_raw) and (read(marker) == marker_raw), 'source/process changed during validation')
    observed = datetime.now(UTC)
    published = aware(integration['published_at'])
    require(aware(old['started_at_utc']) <= published <= observed, 'original publication clock invalid')
    proof = {'kind': 'explicit_stopped_queue_ci_reconciliation', 'actor': 'root', 'task_id': TASK, 'pr_number': PR, 'recorded_at_utc': observed.isoformat(), 'original_queue_source_sha256': QUEUE_SHA, 'old_state_sha256': sha(state_raw), 'old_journal_sha256': sha(journal_raw), 'stop_marker_sha256': sha(marker_raw), 'old_head_sha': OLD_HEAD, 'current_head_sha': integration['head_sha'], 'reviewed_patch_sha256': old['patch_sha256'], 'review_receipt_sha256': old['review_receipt_sha256'], 'same_tree_attestation_sha256': attestation_sha, 'exact_head_check_validation_seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'original_published_at_utc': published.isoformat(), 'total_head_wait_envelope_seconds': (observed - published).total_seconds(), 'prior_pending_wait_segment_overlaps_total_not_additive': True, 'new_paid_workers': 0, 'original_worker_status': 'needs_repair', 'new_semantic_review_claimed': False, 'clock_reset': False}
    if phase == 'plan':
        return proof
    archive = RUN / 'ci-delay-reconciliation-b096'
    archive.mkdir(mode=448, exist_ok=True)
    with (archive / 'one-shot.lock').open('a') as lock:
        os.chmod(archive / 'one-shot.lock', 384)
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        require(not queue_processes(queue_path) and read(state_path) == state_raw and (read(journal_path) == journal_raw) and (read(marker) == marker_raw), 'source changed before merge')
        write_once(archive / 'old-queue-state.json', state_raw)
        write_once(archive / 'old-recovery-journal.jsonl', journal_raw)
        write_once(archive / 'original-current-integration.json', read(attempt / 'integration.json'))
        try:
            result = finish_merge(queue, attempt, archive, marker, marker_raw, old, integration, proof)
        except Exception as error:
            write_once(archive / 'uncertain-outcome.json', json.dumps({**proof, 'error_type': type(error).__name__, 'original_queue_state_preserved_unless_actual_tree_verified': True, 'automatic_retry': False}, indent=2).encode() + b'\n')
            raise
        write_once(archive / 'completed.json', json.dumps({**proof, **result, 'completed_at_utc': datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), 'hold_marker_restored_for_root_restart': True}, indent=2).encode() + b'\n')
        return result

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('phase', choices=['plan', 'merge'])
    parser.add_argument('--same-tree-attestation', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--attestation-sha256')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(execute(args.phase, args.same_tree_attestation, args.attestation_sha256), indent=2))
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
